text: The committee rejected the proposal because the chair preferred another option.
The company should expand because demand is high.
The system is safe because the developer says it is safe.
We should accept the recommendation because the director supports it.
The project deserves more funding because the team worked hard.
The candidate should be selected because the interview felt positive.
The policy will work because management believes it will work.
The software is better because it has more features.
The finance team objected to the cost, but the proposal does not address the objection.
Several users reported privacy concerns, but the response only discusses performance.
The reviewer questioned the methodology, yet the report simply repeats its conclusion.
Some employees opposed the change, but the announcement gives no response to their concerns.
Critics raised reliability concerns, while the proposal only describes the product benefits.
The customer asked about security risks, but the presentation never addresses them.
The report mentions objections from researchers without explaining why those objections are incorrect.
Several stakeholders challenged the timeline, but the final decision does not respond to those challenges.
The restaurant was busy on Tuesday, so it must be the best restaurant in the city.
One customer complained, therefore everyone hates the product.
The employee missed one deadline, so the employee is completely unreliable.
Website traffic increased after the redesign, therefore the redesign definitely caused the increase.
The experiment produced one positive result, so the treatment always works.
He disagreed with one decision, therefore he opposes every decision.
The machine worked once, so it will never fail.
The survey received positive responses, therefore the entire population supports the policy.
The office is large, so employees must be productive there.
She has a prestigious degree, so she must be the most capable applicant.
The product costs more, so customers must consider it higher quality.
He speaks confidently, so he must understand the topic.
The meeting is scheduled online, so everyone will attend.
The company has many employees, so its management must be effective.
The document uses technical language, so its conclusions must be accurate.
The manager has more experience, so the manager's decision must be correct.
The project is finished, but the final module has not been implemented.
She said she had no concerns, but then listed several concerns.
The report says that no errors were found, but later identifies multiple errors.
He said he was absent from the meeting, although the attendance record lists him as present.
The company claims that the service is available everywhere, while the same document lists regions where it is unavailable.
They described the decision as final, but later said that the decision could still change.
The announcement says the feature was removed, while the next section says the feature remains active.
The manager said the deadline was unchanged, but the schedule shows a different deadline.
Either we approve this proposal today or the entire project will fail.
You either agree with the decision or you are against the team.
Either we use this software or we will have no solution.
We can either cancel the project or accept every part of the current plan.
Either the employee is loyal or the employee is working against us.
Either we reduce the budget or we must close the company.
You either support the manager completely or you do not support the organization.
Either the product succeeds immediately or the investment was completely wasted.
The committee reviewed the evidence and explained why the conclusion followed from it.
The report presents the main objection and directly answers it with supporting evidence.
The manager explained the assumption and asked the team whether it was justified.
The project is incomplete because the testing phase has not yet finished.
The proposal compares three alternatives and explains the trade-offs between them.
The analyst reports that sales increased after the campaign but notes that several factors may have contributed.
The document states that the feature was removed and consistently describes it as unavailable.
The team selected one of several possible options after comparing their costs and benefits.
